task: Inspect the full visible constructions in the supplied fixed pair list from original source pixels, recording source facts and concrete ownership evidence before historical claims are revealed.
source: Only source257; supplied geometry and cohort selection condition the inspection. No historical feature prose, pair outcomes, group labels or old reader claims may be read before BOTH initial source-reader reports are frozen.
frames: Right-region writing exact90CW only; bottom/frozen native. No arbitrary rotation/mirroring, scaling, filtering, enhancement, segmentation, OCR, retouching or image generation.
pixel_gate: Independently compare every reused native crop and saved paired panel against original source crop/exact90CW BEFORE first view. Pixel fidelity is not target-binding proof. Labels remain outside source pixels.
route_evidence: Use approved target/base search rectangles only as locators, not contours or ownership masks. Follow the actual complete source route through full context; record competing neighboring routes.

For each target record all visible free ends, bars, returns and their junctions in native-coordinate search regions; distinguish continuous target ink, neighboring ink, bounded detached target marks, and unresolved ownership.
A missing feature requires adequate positive full-route/end visibility on both compared targets. Occlusion, blur, cropped boundary or UNKNOWN cannot establish absence.

Record all eight source-specific features and variations even for deferred pair outcomes. Reuse per-target facts with explicit actual pair-board views; do not manufacture pair inspection by combinatorial prose.

outcomes.SAME_FULL_VISIBLE_FEATURE_CANDIDATE: All eight complete paired source features and target-owned adjuncts are positively compatible under the fixed significant-feature rule; no missing/unknown wildcard or body-only match. This reader candidate is not a released edge until the remaining review gates pass.
outcomes.DIFFERENT_FULL_VISIBLE_GRAPHICS: Positively visible target-owned incompatible topology, enclosure, attachment, or terminal presence, with full relevant ends visible on BOTH targets. A graphical difference is not a cipher cannot-link or proof of different letter identity.
outcomes.VISIBLE_VARIATION_RELATION_UNRESOLVED: A direction, extent, bar-height, arm, curl or return variation is observed but its identity significance is unvalidated; do not force either equality or a negative identity claim.
outcomes.CONNECTION_OR_BINDING_UNRESOLVED: Name the exact unreadable/ambiguous connection, end, mark allocation or target-versus-neighbor route at source coordinates and state which observation is missing.

variation_rule: Translation, photographic texture, thickness/taper and small contour variation may be recorded only where significant topology, attachments, returns and terminal relations remain positively supported. Upper curl, bar height, terminal direction/length, relative arms and narrow returns are not automatically nuisance variation. No numeric threshold is fitted to force a match.
freeze_rule: Each fresh reader freezes its initial observations and whole-pair outcomes before seeing the other initial report or any historical feature/outcome claims. Record prior exposure. Later historical comparisons/corrections are separate immutable addenda and do not count as initial blind agreement.
semantic_limits: No letters, functional/cipher roles, alphabet partition, transitive equivalence, new global reading order or source258/222. Separate AI on the same original pixels is not external expert validation or independent-source corroboration.
geometry_limits: Native boxes are approximate search regions, not ink masks. Region display order and projection order are not reading order; overlapping envelopes do not establish aliases or separate glyphs.
